scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/shared && npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/ui && npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/api && npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/whatsapp-bot && npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/web && npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/shared && npm run build --workspace=@salud-digna/ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
